paragraphs: Advanced Digital Pathway Solutions is a Saudi technology company headquartered in Riyadh, delivering ICT infrastructure, AI, data analytics, software development, cloud and cybersecurity to government and enterprise clients in alignment with Vision 2030.

The Kingdom has the ambition, the capital and a national mandate for AI. The gap is execution: moving AI from pilot to production, meeting NCA controls and the PDPL, finding specialist talent, controlling IT cost and meeting local-content rules. ADP closes that gap.

mission.title: To deliver high-impact, integrated technology solutions that empower public and private sector organizations to modernize, scale and lead in the digital economy.

meta.title: Our model
meta.description: Curate, localize, deliver, operate and transfer: how ADP Solutions turns proven technology into measurable outcomes in Saudi Arabia.

hero.sub: How we turn proven technology into outcomes in the Kingdom, with one accountable Saudi team from the first workshop to handover.

steps.title: Curate
steps.body: We select solutions already proven in production by our global technology alliance and combine them with our own engineering. We only bring what we can stand behind.
points: Fit with your architecture and regulation
Our own engineering where nothing fits

steps.title: Localize
steps.body: We adapt each solution for the Kingdom: Arabic-first interfaces and language models, in-Kingdom or on-premise hosting, and alignment with NCA controls, the PDPL and sector regulators.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: One Saudi contract and one accountable team deliver, integrate and test. Every engagement starts with a fixed-scope proof of value and agreed success measures.

steps.title: Operate & transfer
steps.body: We run what we build, measure it against the agreed outcomes and transfer knowledge to your team, so the capability stays in the Kingdom.

meta.title: Compliance & trust
meta.description: How ADP Solutions aligns delivery with the PDPL, NCA cybersecurity controls, Cloud First, data residency, local content and GCC data-protection laws.

hero.sub: How our delivery aligns with Saudi regulation. We support your compliance; we do not hold or claim regulatory licences on your behalf.

areas.title: The frameworks that shape every engagement

items.title: Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL)
items.body: We design data flows, consent, retention and residency to support your obligations as a controller.

items.title: NCA cybersecurity controls
items.body: Our delivery is aligned to the NCA controls relevant to your environment, from the Essential Cybersecurity Controls to sector-specific sets.

items.title: Cloud First and data residency
items.body: In-Kingdom cloud regions and on-premise options keep data under Saudi jurisdiction.

items.title: Sector regulators
items.body: We align financial-sector work to the SAMA cybersecurity framework and follow health and telecom regulator requirements.

items.title: Local content
items.body: Saudi-headquartered delivery and knowledge transfer support local-content commitments in qualifying tenders.

items.title: GCC data-protection laws
items.body: For regional deployments we take UAE, Bahrain, Oman and Kuwait data-protection laws into account.
